At the end of grid_views.py add BENCH_OHMS_PER_KM = 0.05 and line_loss(voltage_kv, current_a, distance_km) returning {"sent_mw", "loss_mw", "percent"}: if voltage_kv <= 0 or current_a <= 0 all three are 0.0; else sent_mw = voltage_kv * current_a / 1000, loss_mw = current_a ** 2 * BENCH_OHMS_PER_KM * max(0, distance_km) / 1e6, percent = loss_mw / sent_mw * 100.
